purpose: Increase useful session frequency; diagnostic event study, not a strategy or profitability claim
session_definition: 09:30 inclusive to 16:00 exclusive America/New_York (EDT, UTC-04) on each date
input_policy: 13:00 to 20:06 UTC; thirty-minute warm-up and six-minute outcome tail, no future data in detector
selection_policy: Absorption-only controls yielded at most four triggers; enable exhaustion with stricter activity and rejection. Pick the four-band member of the adjacent nine/ten-trigger candidates before inspecting other sessions.
entry_policy: First execution-second close at or after confirmation plus 2000ms publication buffer
outcome_policy: 1R target before 1R stop within five minutes; stop first if both touched within one second; timeouts count as no win; risk is entry to anchor plus one analysis band
control_policy: Same direction and risk, shifted twenty minutes within session; one descriptive control, not statistical qualification
limitations: October 7 is calibration; its 7/10 is in-sample
Frozen comparison and holdout together passed 10/21 vs 8/21 control; evidence of edge is weak
No fees, spread, slippage or fills modeled
The preset seeks useful frequency; it cannot guarantee a signal quota in every session

sources.archive_status: official daily archive returned HTTP 404; no archive published at test time

resources.exporter: existing ServerClient; sequential pages, 200ms spacing, timestamp ties re-fetched, max 24 hours / 2 million executions / 128 MiB output
resources.replay: CSV streamed; at most 90000 execution-second summaries, no raw trade vector
resources.cleanup: Downloaded ZIPs deleted immediately after verified extraction; all three local CSVs deleted after final verification. Only evidence JSON and small scripts/presets retained in Git.
resources.disk_observation: System-wide free disk changed during the check. Test history exports and archive processing ran locally; no server exports or downloads were created. Recorder storage was measured at the end; no unrelated server files were removed.
